definition.name: Orison · relay network
definition.description: Two freighters keep Meridian and Solstice supplied from Equator.
definition.provenance: Planar prescribed Orison/Mote field. Two maintained relays have independent paid controls and assigned visitors. Equator is ballistic, with two berths and one finite fuel inventory replenished by explicit imports. Finite paid transfer/capture, actual docked mass, and bounded online near-Hohmann search.

lanes.name: Orison · flexible service
lanes.description: Tern brings fuel to Meridian, waits aboard, and returns when the orbits line up.
lanes.provenance: Coupled finite-force plans with passive docked mass and paid capture. Funded station top-ups, flexible windows and relay dwell; bounded rolling history.
